verses.original: וַיְהִי֩ אִ֨ישׁ אֶחָ֜ד מִן־ הָרָמָתַ֛יִם צוֹפִ֖ים מֵהַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם וּשְׁמ֡וֹ אֶ֠לְקָנָה בֶּן־ יְרֹחָ֧ם בֶּן־ אֱלִיה֛וּא בֶּן־ תֹּ֥חוּ בֶן־ צ֖וּף אֶפְרָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ’îš ’e·ḥāḏ min- hā·rā·mā·ṯa·yim ṣō·w·p̄îm mê·har ’ep̄·rā·yim ū·šə·mōw ’el·qā·nāh ben- yə·rō·ḥām ben- ’ĕ·lî·hū ben- tō·ḥū ḇen- ṣūp̄ ’ep̄·rā·ṯî
verses.literal: Now there was a man named Elkanah who was from Ramathaim-zophim in the hill country of Ephraim He was the son of Jeroham the son of Elihu the son of Tohu the son of Zuph an Ephraimite
verses.literalPt: HOUVE um homem de Ramataim-Zofim, da montanha de Efraim, cujo nome era Elcana, filho de Jeroão, filho de Eliú, filho de Toú, filho de Zufe, efrateu.

verses.original: וְלוֹ֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י נָשִׁ֔ים שֵׁ֤ם אַחַת֙ חַנָּ֔ה וְשֵׁ֥ם הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית פְּנִנָּ֑ה וַיְהִ֤י לִפְנִנָּה֙ יְלָדִ֔ים וּלְחַנָּ֖ה אֵ֥ין יְלָדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lōw šə·tê nā·šîm šêm ’a·ḥaṯ ḥan·nāh wə·šêm haš·šê·nîṯ pə·nin·nāh way·hî lip̄·nin·nāh yə·lā·ḏîm ū·lə·ḥan·nāh ’ên yə·lā·ḏîm
verses.literal: He had two wives one named Hannah . . . and the other Peninnah And Peninnah had children but Hannah had none . . .
verses.literalPt: E este tinha duas mulheres: o nome de uma era Ana, e o da outra Penina. E Penina tinha filhos, porém Ana não os tinha.

verses.original: וְעָלָה֩ הָאִ֨ישׁ הַה֤וּא מֵֽעִירוֹ֙ מִיָּמִ֣ים׀ יָמִ֔ימָה לְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֧ת וְלִזְבֹּ֛חַ לַיהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת בְּשִׁלֹ֑ה וְשָׁ֞ם שְׁנֵ֣י בְנֵֽי־ עֵלִ֗י חָפְנִי֙ וּפִ֣נְחָ֔ס כֹּהֲנִ֖ים לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·lāh hā·’îš ha·hū mê·‘î·rōw mî·yā·mîm yā·mî·māh lə·hiš·ta·ḥă·wōṯ wə·liz·bō·aḥ Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ bə·ši·lōh wə·šām šə·nê ḇə·nê- ‘ê·lî ḥā·p̄ə·nî ū·p̄in·ḥās kō·hă·nîm Yah·weh
verses.literal: Year after year . . . Elkanah . . . would go up from his city to worship and sacrifice to the LORD of Hosts at Shiloh where Eli’s two sons Hophni and Phinehas were priests to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Subia, pois, este homem, da sua cidade, de ano em ano, a adorar e a sacrificar ao SENHOR dos Exércitos em Siló; e estavam ali os sacerdotes do SENHOR, Hofni e Finéias, os dois filhos de Eli.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י הַיּ֔וֹם וַיִּזְבַּ֖ח אֶלְקָנָ֑ה וְנָתַ֞ן לִפְנִנָּ֣ה אִשְׁתּ֗וֹ וּֽלְכָל־ בָּנֶ֛יהָ וּבְנוֹתֶ֖יהָ מָנֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî hay·yō·wm way·yiz·baḥ ’el·qā·nāh wə·nā·ṯan lip̄·nin·nāh ’iš·tōw ū·lə·ḵāl- bā·ne·hā ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯe·hā mā·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: And whenever the day came for Elkanah to present his sacrifice he would give portions to his wife Peninnah and to all her sons and daughters
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que no dia em que Elcana sacrificava, dava ele porções a Penina, sua mulher, e a todos os seus filhos, e a todas as suas filhas.

verses.original: וּלְחַנָּ֕ה יִתֵּ֛ן מָנָ֥ה אַחַ֖ת אַפָּ֑יִם כִּ֤י אֶת־ חַנָּה֙ אָהֵ֔ב וַֽיהוָ֖ה סָגַ֥ר רַחְמָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·ḥan·nāh yit·tên mā·nāh ’a·ḥaṯ ’ap·pā·yim kî ’eṯ- ḥan·nāh ’ā·hêḇ Yah·weh sā·ḡar raḥ·māh
verses.literal: But to Hannah he would give a double portion for he loved her even though the LORD had closed her womb
verses.literalPt: Porém a Ana dava uma parte excelente; porque amava a Ana, embora o SENHOR lhe tivesse cerrado a madre.

verses.original: וְכִֽעֲסַ֤תָּה צָֽרָתָהּ֙ גַּם־ כַּ֔עַס בַּעֲב֖וּר הַרְּעִמָ֑הּ כִּֽי־ סָגַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה בְּעַ֥ד רַחְמָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵi·‘ă·sat·tāh ṣā·rā·ṯāh gam- ka·‘as ba·‘ă·ḇūr har·rə·‘i·māh kî- sā·ḡar Yah·weh bə·‘aḏ raḥ·māh
verses.literal: Because the LORD had closed Hannah’s womb her rival . . . would provoke her viciously to taunt her
verses.literalPt: E a sua rival excessivamente a provocava, para a irritar; porque o SENHOR lhe tinha cerrado a madre.

verses.original: וְכֵ֨ן יַעֲשֶׂ֜ה שָׁנָ֣ה בְשָׁנָ֗ה מִדֵּ֤י עֲלֹתָהּ֙ בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה כֵּ֖ן תַּכְעִסֶ֑נָּה וַתִּבְכֶּ֖ה וְלֹ֥א תֹאכַֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵên ya·‘ă·śeh šā·nāh ḇə·šā·nāh mid·dê ‘ă·lō·ṯāh bə·ḇêṯ Yah·weh kên taḵ·‘i·sen·nāh wat·tiḇ·keh wə·lō ṯō·ḵal
verses.literal: And this went on . . . year after year Whenever Hannah went up to the house of the LORD her rival taunted her until she wept and would not eat
verses.literalPt: E assim fazia ele de ano em ano. Sempre que Ana subia à casa do SENHOR, a outra a irritava; por isso chorava, e não comia.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר לָ֜הּ אֶלְקָנָ֣ה אִישָׁ֗הּ חַנָּה֙ לָ֣מֶה תִבְכִּ֗י וְלָ֙מֶה֙ לֹ֣א תֹֽאכְלִ֔י וְלָ֖מֶה יֵרַ֣ע לְבָבֵ֑ךְ הֲל֤וֹא אָֽנֹכִי֙ ט֣וֹב לָ֔ךְ מֵעֲשָׂרָ֖ה בָּנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lāh ’el·qā·nāh ’î·šāh ḥan·nāh lā·meh ṯiḇ·kî wə·lā·meh lō ṯō·ḵə·lî wə·lā·meh yê·ra‘ lə·ḇā·ḇêḵ hă·lō·w ’ā·nō·ḵî ṭō·wḇ lāḵ mê·‘ă·śā·rāh bā·nîm
verses.literal: Hannah why are you crying her husband Elkanah asked Why won’t you eat Why is your heart so grieved Am I not better to you than ten sons
verses.literalPt: Então Elcana, seu marido, lhe disse: Ana, por que choras? E por que não comes? E por que está mal o teu coração? Não te sou eu melhor do que dez filhos?

verses.original: וַתָּ֣קָם חַנָּ֔ה אַחֲרֵ֛י אָכְלָ֥ה בְשִׁלֹ֖ה וְאַחֲרֵ֣י שָׁתֹ֑ה וְעֵלִ֣י הַכֹּהֵ֗ן יֹשֵׁב֙ עַל־ הַכִּסֵּ֔א עַל־ מְזוּזַ֖ת הֵיכַ֥ל יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tā·qām ḥan·nāh ’a·ḥă·rê ’ā·ḵə·lāh ḇə·ši·lōh wə·’a·ḥă·rê šā·ṯōh wə·‘ê·lî hak·kō·hên yō·šêḇ ‘al- hak·kis·sê ‘al- mə·zū·zaṯ hê·ḵal Yah·weh
verses.literal: So after they had finished eating and drinking in Shiloh Hannah stood up . . . Now Eli the priest was sitting on a chair by the doorpost of the temple of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Então Ana se levantou, depois que comeram e beberam em Siló; e Eli, sacerdote, estava assentado numa cadeira, junto a um pilar do templo do SENHOR.

verses.original: וְהִ֖יא מָ֣רַת נָ֑פֶשׁ וַתִּתְפַּלֵּ֥ל עַל־ יְהוָ֖ה וּבָכֹ֥ה תִבְכֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hî mā·raṯ nā·p̄eš wat·tiṯ·pal·lêl ‘al- Yah·weh ū·ḇā·ḵōh ṯiḇ·keh
verses.literal: In her bitter distress . . . Hannah prayed to the LORD and wept with many tears . . .
verses.literalPt: Ela, pois, com amargura de alma, orou ao SENHOR, e chorou abundantemente.

verses.original: וַתִּדֹּ֨ר נֶ֜דֶר וַתֹּאמַ֗ר יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אִם־ רָאֹ֥ה תִרְאֶ֣ה׀ בָּעֳנִ֣י אֲמָתֶ֗ךָ וּזְכַרְתַּ֙נִי֙ וְלֹֽא־ תִשְׁכַּ֣ח אֶת־ אֲמָתֶ֔ךָ וְנָתַתָּ֥ה לַאֲמָתְךָ֖ זֶ֣רַע אֲנָשִׁ֑ים וּנְתַתִּ֤יו לַֽיהוָה֙ כָּל־ יְמֵ֣י חַיָּ֔יו וּמוֹרָ֖ה לֹא־ יַעֲלֶ֥ה עַל־ רֹאשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tid·dōr ne·ḏer wat·tō·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’im- rā·’ōh ṯir·’eh bā·‘o·nî ’ă·mā·ṯe·ḵā ū·zə·ḵar·ta·nî wə·lō- ṯiš·kaḥ ’eṯ- ’ă·mā·ṯe·ḵā wə·nā·ṯat·tāh la·’ă·mā·ṯə·ḵā ze·ra‘ ’ă·nā·šîm ū·nə·ṯat·tîw Yah·weh kāl- yə·mê ḥay·yāw ū·mō·w·rāh lō- ya·‘ă·leh ‘al- rō·šōw
verses.literal: And she made a vow saying O LORD of Hosts if only You will look . . . upon the affliction of Your maidservant and remember me not forgetting Your maidservant but giving . . . her a son . . . then I will dedicate him to the LORD all the days of his life and no razor shall ever touch . . . his head
verses.literalPt: E fez um voto, dizendo: SENHOR dos Exércitos! Se benignamente atentares para a aflição da tua serva, e de mim te lembrares, e da tua serva não te esqueceres, mas à tua serva deres um filho homem, ao SENHOR o darei todos os dias da sua vida, e sobre a sua cabeça não passará navalha.

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ כִּ֣י הִרְבְּתָ֔ה לְהִתְפַּלֵּ֖ל לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְעֵלִ֖י שֹׁמֵ֥ר אֶת־ פִּֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh kî hir·bə·ṯāh lə·hiṯ·pal·lêl lip̄·nê Yah·weh wə·‘ê·lî šō·mêr ’eṯ- pî·hā
verses.literal: As Hannah kept on praying before the LORD Eli watched her mouth
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que, perseverando ela em orar perante o SENHOR, Eli observou a sua boca.

verses.original: וְחַנָּ֗ה הִ֚יא מְדַבֶּ֣רֶת עַל־ לִבָּ֔הּ רַ֚ק שְׂפָתֶ֣יהָ נָּע֔וֹת וְקוֹלָ֖הּ לֹ֣א יִשָּׁמֵ֑עַ וַיַּחְשְׁבֶ֥הָ עֵלִ֖י לְשִׁכֹּרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥan·nāh hî mə·ḏab·be·reṯ ‘al- lib·bāh raq śə·p̄ā·ṯe·hā nā·‘ō·wṯ wə·qō·w·lāh lō yiš·šā·mê·a‘ way·yaḥ·šə·ḇe·hā ‘ê·lî lə·šik·kō·rāh
verses.literal: Hannah . . . was praying in her heart and though her lips were moving her voice could not be heard So Eli thought she was drunk
verses.literalPt: Porquanto Ana no seu coração falava; só se moviam os seus lábios, porém não se ouvia a sua voz; pelo que Eli a teve por embriagada.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלֶ֙יהָ֙ עֵלִ֔י עַד־ מָתַ֖י תִּשְׁתַּכָּרִ֑ין הָסִ֥ירִי אֶת־ יֵינֵ֖ךְ מֵעָלָֽיִךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·le·hā ‘ê·lî ‘aḏ- mā·ṯay tiš·tak·kā·rîn hā·sî·rî ’eṯ- yê·nêḵ mê·‘ā·lā·yiḵ
verses.literal: and said to her . . . How long will you be drunk Put away your wine . . .
verses.literalPt: E disse-lhe Eli: Até quando estarás tu embriagada? Aparta de ti o teu vinho.

verses.original: וַתַּ֨עַן חַנָּ֤ה וַתֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לֹ֣א אֲדֹנִ֔י אִשָּׁ֤ה קְשַׁת־ ר֙וּחַ֙ אָנֹ֔כִי וְיַ֥יִן וְשֵׁכָ֖ר לֹ֣א שָׁתִ֑יתִי וָאֶשְׁפֹּ֥ךְ אֶת־ נַפְשִׁ֖י לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wat·ta·‘an ḥan·nāh wat·tō·mer lō ’ă·ḏō·nî ’iš·šāh qə·šaṯ- rū·aḥ ’ā·nō·ḵî wə·ya·yin wə·šê·ḵār lō šā·ṯî·ṯî wā·’eš·pōḵ ’eṯ- nap̄·šî lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: No my lord Hannah . . . replied I am a woman troubled in spirit I have not had any wine or strong drink but I have poured out my soul before the LORD
verses.literalPt: Porém Ana respondeu: Não, senhor meu, eu sou uma mulher atribulada de espírito; nem vinho nem bebida forte tenho bebido; porém tenho derramado a minha alma perante o SENHOR.

verses.original: אַל־ תִּתֵּן֙ אֶת־ אֲמָ֣תְךָ֔ לִפְנֵ֖י בַּת־ בְּלִיָּ֑עַל כִּֽי־ מֵרֹ֥ב שִׂיחִ֛י וְכַעְסִ֖י דִּבַּ֥רְתִּי עַד־ הֵֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tit·tên ’eṯ- ’ă·mā·ṯə·ḵā lip̄·nê baṯ- bə·lî·yā·‘al kî- mê·rōḇ śî·ḥî wə·ḵa‘·sî dib·bar·tî ‘aḏ- hên·nāh
verses.literal: Do not take - your servant for a wicked . . . woman for all this time . . . I have been praying out of the depth of my anguish and grief
verses.literalPt: Não tenhas, pois, a tua serva por filha de Belial; porque da multidão dos meus cuidados e do meu desgosto tenho falado até agora.

verses.original: וַיַּ֧עַן עֵלִ֛י וַיֹּ֖אמֶר לְכִ֣י לְשָׁל֑וֹם וֵאלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל יִתֵּן֙ אֶת־ שֵׁ֣לָתֵ֔ךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁאַ֖לְתְּ מֵעִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an ‘ê·lî way·yō·mer lə·ḵî lə·šā·lō·wm wê·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl yit·tên ’eṯ- šê·lā·ṯêḵ ’ă·šer šā·’alt mê·‘im·mōw
verses.literal: Go in peace Eli . . . replied and may the God of Israel grant the petition you have asked of Him
verses.literalPt: Então respondeu Eli: Vai em paz; e o Deus de Israel te conceda a petição que lhe fizeste.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֕אמֶר תִּמְצָ֧א שִׁפְחָתְךָ֛ חֵ֖ן בְּעֵינֶ֑יךָ וַתֵּ֨לֶךְ הָאִשָּׁ֤ה לְדַרְכָּהּ֙ וַתֹּאכַ֔ל וּפָנֶ֥יהָ לֹא־ הָיוּ־ לָ֖הּ עֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer tim·ṣā šip̄·ḥā·ṯə·ḵā ḥên bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā wat·tê·leḵ hā·’iš·šāh lə·ḏar·kāh wat·tō·ḵal ū·p̄ā·ne·hā lō- hā·yū- lāh ‘ō·wḏ
verses.literal: May your maidservant find favor with you said Hannah Then she went on her way and she began to eat and her face was no longer downcast
verses.literalPt: E disse ela: Ache a tua serva graça aos teus olhos. Assim a mulher foi o seu caminho, e comeu, e o seu semblante já não era triste.

verses.original: וַיַּשְׁכִּ֣מוּ בַבֹּ֗קֶר וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲווּ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַיָּשֻׁ֛בוּ וַיָּבֹ֥אוּ אֶל־ בֵּיתָ֖ם הָרָמָ֑תָה וַיֵּ֤דַע אֶלְקָנָה֙ אֶת־ חַנָּ֣ה אִשְׁתּ֔וֹ וַיִּֽזְכְּרֶ֖הָ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaš·ki·mū ḇab·bō·qer way·yiš·ta·ḥă·wū lip̄·nê Yah·weh way·yā·šu·ḇū way·yā·ḇō·’ū ’el- bê·ṯām hā·rā·mā·ṯāh way·yê·ḏa‘ ’el·qā·nāh ’eṯ- ḥan·nāh ’iš·tōw way·yiz·kə·re·hā Yah·weh
verses.literal: The next morning they got up early to bow in worship before the LORD and then they returned . . . . . . home to Ramah And Elkanah had relations with his wife Hannah and the LORD remembered her
verses.literalPt: E levantaram-se de madrugada, e adoraram perante o SENHOR, e voltaram, e chegaram à sua casa, em Ramá, e Elcana conheceu a Ana sua mulher, e o SENHOR se lembrou dela.

verses.original: וַיְהִי֙ לִתְקֻפ֣וֹת הַיָּמִ֔ים וַתַּ֥הַר חַנָּ֖ה וַתֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֑ן וַתִּקְרָ֤א אֶת־ שְׁמוֹ֙ שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל כִּ֥י מֵיְהוָ֖ה שְׁאִלְתִּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî liṯ·qu·p̄ō·wṯ hay·yā·mîm wat·ta·har ḥan·nāh wat·tê·leḏ bên wat·tiq·rā ’eṯ- šə·mōw šə·mū·’êl kî Yah·weh šə·’il·tîw
verses.literal: So in the course of time Hannah conceived and gave birth to a son She named him Samuel saying, “Because I have asked for him from the LORD
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que, passado algum tempo, Ana concebeu, e deu à luz um filho, ao qual chamou Samuel; porque, dizia ela, o tenho pedido ao SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיַּ֛עַל הָאִ֥ישׁ אֶלְקָנָ֖ה וְכָל־ בֵּית֑וֹ לִזְבֹּ֧חַ לַֽיהוָ֛ה אֶת־ זֶ֥בַח הַיָּמִ֖ים וְאֶת־ נִדְרֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘al hā·’îš ’el·qā·nāh wə·ḵāl bê·ṯōw liz·bō·aḥ Yah·weh ’eṯ- ze·ḇaḥ hay·yā·mîm wə·’eṯ- niḏ·rōw
verses.literal: Then Elkanah and all his house went up . . . to make the annual sacrifice to the LORD and to fulfill his vow
verses.literalPt: E subiu aquele homem Elcana com toda a sua casa, a oferecer ao SENHOR o sacrifício anual e a cumprir o seu voto.

verses.original: וְחַנָּ֖ה לֹ֣א עָלָ֑תָה כִּֽי־ אָמְרָ֣ה לְאִישָׁ֗הּ עַ֣ד יִגָּמֵ֤ל הַנַּ֙עַר֙ וַהֲבִאֹתִ֗יו וְנִרְאָה֙ אֶת־ פְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וְיָ֥שַׁב שָׁ֖ם עַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥan·nāh lō ‘ā·lā·ṯāh kî- ’ā·mə·rāh lə·’î·šāh ‘aḏ yig·gā·mêl han·na·‘ar wa·hă·ḇi·’ō·ṯîw wə·nir·’āh ’eṯ- pə·nê Yah·weh wə·yā·šaḇ šām ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: but Hannah did not go After the boy is weaned she said to her husband I will take him to appear . . . before the LORD and to stay there permanently . . .
verses.literalPt: Porém Ana não subiu; mas disse a seu marido: Quando o menino for desmamado, então o levarei, para que apareça perante o SENHOR, e lá fique para sempre.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָהּ֩ אֶלְקָנָ֨ה אִישָׁ֜הּ עֲשִׂ֧י הַטּ֣וֹב בְּעֵינַ֗יִךְ שְׁבִי֙ עַד־ גָּמְלֵ֣ךְ אֹת֔וֹ אַ֛ךְ יָקֵ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ דְּבָר֑וֹ וַתֵּ֤שֶׁב הָֽאִשָּׁה֙ וַתֵּ֣ינֶק אֶת־ בְּנָ֔הּ עַד־ גָּמְלָ֖הּ אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lāh ’el·qā·nāh ’î·šāh ‘ă·śî haṭ·ṭō·wḇ bə·‘ê·na·yiḵ šə·ḇî ‘aḏ- gā·mə·lêḵ ’ō·ṯōw ’aḵ yā·qêm Yah·weh ’eṯ- də·ḇā·rōw wat·tê·šeḇ hā·’iš·šāh wat·tê·neq ’eṯ- bə·nāh ‘aḏ- ḡā·mə·lāh ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: Do what you think is best her husband Elkanah replied and stay here until you have weaned him Only may the LORD confirm His word So Hannah stayed and nursed her son until she had weaned him
verses.literalPt: E Elcana, seu marido, lhe disse: Faze o que bem te parecer aos teus olhos; fica até que o desmames; então somente confirme o SENHOR a sua palavra. Assim ficou a mulher, e deu leite a seu filho, até que o desmamou.

verses.original: וַתַּעֲלֵ֨הוּ עִמָּ֜הּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר גְּמָלַ֗תּוּ בְּפָרִ֤ים שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ וְאֵיפָ֨ה אַחַ֥ת קֶ֙מַח֙ וְנֵ֣בֶל יַ֔יִן וַתְּבִאֵ֥הוּ בֵית־ יְהוָ֖ה שִׁל֑וֹ וְהַנַּ֖עַר נָֽעַר׃
verses.transliteration: wat·ta·‘ă·lê·hū ‘im·māh ka·’ă·šer gə·mā·lat·tū bə·p̄ā·rîm šə·lō·šāh wə·’ê·p̄āh ’a·ḥaṯ qe·maḥ wə·nê·ḇel ya·yin wat·tə·ḇi·’ê·hū ḇêṯ- Yah·weh ši·lōw wə·han·na·‘ar nā·‘ar
verses.literal: Once she had weaned him Hannah took the boy with her along with a three-year-old bull an ephah . . . of flour and a skin of wine Though the boy was still young she brought him to the house of the LORD at Shiloh
verses.literalPt: E, havendo-o desmamado, tomou-o consigo, com três bezerros, e um efa de farinha, e um odre de vinho, e levou-o à casa do SENHOR, em Siló, e era o menino ainda muito criança.

verses.original: וַֽיִּשְׁחֲט֖וּ אֶת־ הַפָּ֑ר וַיָּבִ֥יאוּ אֶת־ הַנַּ֖עַר אֶל־ עֵלִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ḥă·ṭū ’eṯ- hap·pār way·yā·ḇî·’ū ’eṯ- han·na·‘ar ’el- ‘ê·lî
verses.literal: And when they had slaughtered the bull they brought the boy to Eli
verses.literalPt: E degolaram um bezerro, e trouxeram o menino a Eli.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֙אמֶר֙ בִּ֣י אֲדֹנִ֔י חֵ֥י נַפְשְׁךָ֖ אֲדֹנִ֑י אֲנִ֣י הָאִשָּׁ֗ה הַנִּצֶּ֤בֶת עִמְּכָה֙ בָּזֶ֔ה לְהִתְפַּלֵּ֖ל אֶל־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer bî ’ă·ḏō·nî ḥê nap̄·šə·ḵā ’ă·ḏō·nî ’ă·nî hā·’iš·šāh han·niṣ·ṣe·ḇeṯ ‘im·mə·ḵāh bā·zeh lə·hiṯ·pal·lêl ’el- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Please my lord said Hannah as surely as you live my lord I am the woman who stood here beside you praying to the LORD
verses.literalPt: E disse ela: Ah, meu senhor, viva a tua alma, meu SENHOR; eu sou aquela mulher que aqui esteve contigo, para orar ao SENHOR.

verses.original: אֶל־ הַנַּ֥עַר הַזֶּ֖ה הִתְפַּלָּ֑לְתִּי וַיִּתֵּ֨ן יְהוָ֥ה לִי֙ אֶת־ שְׁאֵ֣לָתִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁאַ֖לְתִּי מֵעִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’el- han·na·‘ar haz·zeh hiṯ·pal·lā·lə·tî way·yit·tên Yah·weh lî ’eṯ- šə·’ê·lā·ṯî ’ă·šer šā·’al·tî mê·‘im·mōw
verses.literal: I prayed for this boy and since the LORD has granted me - what I asked of Him
verses.literalPt: Por este menino orava eu; e o SENHOR atendeu à minha petição, que eu lhe tinha feito.

verses.original: וְגַ֣ם אָנֹכִ֗י הִשְׁאִלְתִּ֙הוּ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה כָּל־ הַיָּמִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֔ה ה֥וּא שָׁא֖וּל לַֽיהוָ֑ה וַיִּשְׁתַּ֥חוּ שָׁ֖ם לַיהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam ’ā·nō·ḵî hiš·’il·ti·hū Yah·weh kāl- hay·yā·mîm ’ă·šer hā·yāh hū šā·’ūl Yah·weh way·yiš·ta·ḥū šām Yah·weh
verses.literal: I now dedicate the boy to the LORD For as . . . long as he lives he is dedicated to the LORD So they worshiped the LORD there
verses.literalPt: Por isso também ao SENHOR eu o entreguei, por todos os dias que viver, pois ao SENHOR foi pedido. E adorou ali ao SENHOR.
